paragraphs: MedLex Solutions is the first specialised forensic psychiatry training and consultation centre in the MENA region. We work along two lines that reinforce each other: structured training that equips psychiatrists with the forensic competence courts expect, and expert consultation that gives judicial and governmental institutions evaluations they can rely on.

The method is deliberately unglamorous — defined questions, documented reasoning, traceable sources, and conclusions stated at the confidence the evidence actually supports. That structure is what makes an opinion admissible, and it is also what protects the clinician who signed it.

We are not importing a model wholesale. Programmes are built around the legal frameworks practitioners here actually appear under, then aligned with international forensic standards rather than the other way round.
who.quote: We’re not just training psychiatrists — we’re building the professional standard where clinical expertise becomes court-admissible evidence.

profile.name: Dr. Ahmed Abouelghit
profile.caption: DR. AHMED ABOUELGHIT · CONSULTANT
paragraphs: Consultant Forensic Psychiatrist, UK-trained, with broad international experience across Egypt, the United Kingdom, and Qatar. His work sits at the intersection of psychiatry, law, and institutional practice, with a focus on forensic assessment, medico-legal opinion, and the standards required in legally sensitive clinical settings.

As Forensic Psychiatry Training Program Director, he is actively involved in advancing specialist education and promoting high standards in forensic practice. His medico-legal experience was shaped in the United Kingdom across mental health tribunals, Magistrates' Courts, Crown Court, and the Parole Board - a practical understanding of how psychiatric opinion is examined in legal settings.

Alongside senior clinical and educational roles, he has contributed to professional training across the region, including consultancy work with UNICEF in Egypt supporting legal authorities. Through MedLex, he offers expert-led, court-conscious, and practice-grounded guidance in forensic and medico-legal psychiatry.

pillars.title: Scientific rigour
pillars.description: Method before conclusion. Structured instruments, documented reasoning, and opinions stated at the confidence the evidence supports.

pillars.title: Legal alignment
pillars.description: Reports written to answer the legal question posed, in the framework of the jurisdiction hearing it - not a clinical summary handed to a court.

pillars.title: Professional protection
pillars.description: A defensible methodology is a clinician's protection. We teach the record-keeping and reasoning that hold up when the opinion is challenged.

pillars.title: Regional relevance
pillars.description: International standards, applied to the courts and institutions practitioners here actually appear before.
